substantive_visual.observation: Large light intervals and pavement joints create an urban ground scene. The recognizable forefoot/heel and partly cropped second print communicate passage and slow stepping; scene boundaries structure the whole frame.

assigned_style.observation: Sharp large blue/yellow planes, delicate precise seams and localized worn red prints create the assigned active graphic expression. Neutral accent is absent and faint broad yellow variation remains.

hangul.observation: The full title and body are readable, with coherent broad sans serif title bodies and regular mature body forms. Counters and word spaces remain open, baselines consistent. The blue window strip no longer merges with top edges of the first title word.

information_relationship.location: Upper-left title to directly adjacent four-line paragraph
information_relationship.observation: Title is immediate main typographic anchor at thumbnail. Same left start and close position lead into a comfortable four-line explanatory block at usage720, then the broad diagonal scene and worn traces.

basic_style_exclusion.location: Whole frame at usage720 and thumbnail320
basic_style_exclusion.observation: Large window-light intervals and crossed pavement seams, plus large cropped shoe traces, create the composition. The scene is substantive and extends around and beyond the text rather than functioning as a small added image on a passive information board.

material_edge_finish.location: Blue/yellow boundaries, narrow seams and red traces
material_edge_finish.observation: Precise sharp borders and clean thin lines are visible. Grain is confined to actual worn print interruptions; faint broad yellow tonal variation is a remaining finish limit.

located_observations.observation: No overlapping blue window strip remains inside the title glyph boundary.
The entire description reads in sequence with clear Hangul and punctuation at the larger body scale.
One-line title, yellow-blue diagonal city-ground planes and two red step traces remain distinct anchors.

residuals.observation: Very faint broad tonal variation remains rather than absolutely uniform solid color.
The initial neutral cream junction is now yellow light; the dark blue body stays clear, but the neutral accent of the assigned palette is absent.

selection_reason: Compared with initial and repair-1, repair-2 retains exact copy and comfortable larger four-line body while separating the title from crossing window graphic and preserving the substantive urban scene.
